chart-wrapper.purpose: Standardize chart title, summary value, legend, tooltip copy, empty states, export, and accessible data summary around a chart component.
useWhen: Dashboard charts need consistent heading, metadata, and state handling.
Users need to compare trends without losing source or filter context.
A chart requires accessible summary and non-visual fallback.
doNotUseWithoutReview: The chart type, source, or comparison period is unclear.
The chart needs exploratory analytics beyond dashboard summary.
Legend interaction changes regulated or financial interpretation.
foundations: Defines chart container height, header density, legend placement, and responsive stacking.
Owns chart title, summary, caption, tooltip labels, and empty copy.
Controls series emphasis, selected state, and semantic status without overriding Design System color tokens.
Loaded, loading, empty, filtered-empty, error, and stale states are explicit.
Tooltips and export menus float above the chart without turning the chart into a nested card.
Charts expose text summary, table fallback, and keyboard reachable controls.
slots: Primary visual chart with title, value, caption, and data points.
Optional metric summary or threshold metadata.
Export, compare, or series visibility controls.
Represents loading, empty, and error conditions.
Accessible non-visual summary of chart values.
variants: Header, chart, caption, and summary data align in a dashboard module.
Empty State explains the filter and recovery.
Export uses Button/Menu and preserves filter context.
motion: Bars or values update without jumpy layout or decorative animation.
Uses Design System overlay motion and reduced-motion fallback.
Loading, empty, and chart content preserve module dimensions.
accessibility: Chart has an accessible title and summary.
Data is available as text through List or Table.
Color is not the only way to distinguish series or state.
tests: Chart header, controls, and plot do not overlap.
Empty and loading states preserve layout.
Data summary is present for screen readers.
Export or menu action uses Design System controls.

canDecide: Use Chart Wrapper for dashboard trend or comparison modules.
Use Chart Panel for compact visual summaries.
Show Empty State when filters remove all data.
mustAsk: Data source, chart type, comparison period, legend behavior, or export policy is unclear.
The chart represents financial or compliance reporting.
rejectIf: The chart changes Design System colors directly.
Loading or empty state causes layout shift.
miel.handoff: Confirm chart source, comparison period, summary metric, export rules, accessible data summary, and empty/error behavior.
